process_area.title: Marketplace Catalog, Order Routing & Seller Fulfillment

fields.Participants: Marketplace Mgr, Catalog Ops (links to VS-01/VS-10), Ecommerce (links to VS-10), BI (links to VS-28)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Catalog Ops merge 1P and 3P offers into unified catalog per product taxonomy" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-monitor of "monitors catalog health" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-515 (ensure controlled execution — Marketplace Catalog, Order Routing & Seller Fulfillment (PA-95.2).)
- operational: dedup rules and quality gating
Pain Points / Risks: - **Search-clutter risk**: Duplicate/spammy listings degrade discovery; mitigated by dedup rules and quality gating
System Touchpoints: - Unified catalog/search (links to VS-10/VS-29); retail-media boosting (links to VS-48); listing-quality score (W3140)

steps.activity: Catalog Ops merge 1P and 3P offers into unified catalog per product taxonomy (links to VS-01); each SKU page may show 1P offer + multiple 3P offers with buy-box logic (W3146)

Ecommerce tune search relevance: combine title/spec/keyword/category; boost by listing quality (W3140), seller performance (W3154), conversion, and sponsorship (links to VS-48 retail media); apply merchandising rules (featured, new arrivals, top-rated)
Marketplace Mgr monitors catalog health: duplicate listings, miscategorization, prohibited items (links to W3156 policy), price anomalies, out-of-date content; remediate with sellers

fields.Participants: Marketplace Mgr, Ecommerce (links to VS-10), Category (links to VS-01), Finance

workflows.name: First-Party vs Third-Party Offer Comparison & Buy-Box

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitor buy-box distribution" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-515 (ensure controlled execution — Marketplace Catalog, Order Routing & Seller Fulfillment (PA-95.2).)
- operational: transparent, performance-based algorithm and documented rules
Pain Points / Risks: - **Self-preferencing risk**: Always favoring 1P attracts competition-law scrutiny; mitigated by transparent, performance-based algorithm and documented rules
System Touchpoints: - Buy-box engine; pricing master (links to VS-01); seller performance (links to W3154)

steps.activity: System computes buy-box winner per multi-offer SKU using weighted algorithm: total price (item + shipping + tax), seller performance (W3154), fulfillment speed, in-stock, returns policy; surfaces "Other Sellers" panel for runners-up

Category (links to VS-01) sets 1P/3P rules: categories where 1P wins by policy (private label — links to VS-41, controlled brands), categories open to 3P, and categories where 3P complements 1P (vendor direct-ship for out-of-stock)
Marketplace Mgr monitor buy-box distribution: 1P share vs. 3P share, seller diversity, price competitiveness; flag anomalies (price war, seller dominance) and adjust rules

fields.Participants: Marketplace Mgr, Ecommerce (links to VS-10), Fraud/LP (links to VS-23), Seller Operations

workflows.name: Marketplace Order Capture, Fraud Screening & Routing

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "captures order" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-generate of "fingerprint, address risk" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-route of "routes sub-order to seller" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: multi-signal fraud screening and seller vetting (W3138)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Marketplace fraud risk**: Higher than 1P; mitigated by multi-signal fraud screening and seller vetting (W3138)
System Touchpoints: - Order capture (links to VS-10/VS-60); fraud screening (links to VS-23); seller routing; reservation (W3150)

steps.activity: Ecommerce (links to VS-10) captures order; for multi-seller basket (W3149) splits into per-seller sub-orders; reserves seller inventory (W3150); computes total price incl. shipping, tax, fees

Fraud/LP (links to VS-23) screen order: payment fraud, fake/compromised account, first-party fraud, promo abuse (links to W3152); velocity rules, device fingerprint, address risk; hold/cancel/review suspicious orders

Marketplace routes sub-order to seller (or to BuildRight fulfillment — Fulfilled-by-BuildRight — links to VS-93) with fulfillment SLA, shipping label, customer address; seller acknowledges and begins fulfillment (W3148)

fields.Participants: Marketplace Mgr, Seller, Carrier/3PL (links to VS-56), CS (links to VS-13)

workflows.name: Seller Fulfillment SLA, Shipment Tracking & POD

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-generate of "generate carrier label, manifest, hand-off to carrier" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "System captures tracking events" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-monitor of "monitor SLA adherence" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-515 (ensure controlled execution — Marketplace Catalog, Order Routing & Seller Fulfillment (PA-95.2).)
- operational: SLA monitoring, penalty, and Fulfill-by-BuildRight option
Pain Points / Risks: - **Late-ship risk**: Seller SLA breach hurts customer experience; mitigated by SLA monitoring, penalty, and Fulfill-by-BuildRight option
System Touchpoints: - Carrier API (links to VS-56); tracking/customer comms (links to VS-10/VS-13); seller scorecard (links to W3154)

steps.activity: Seller fulfills per SLA (e.g., ship within 24–48 hr); for BuildRight-fulfilled (links to VS-93), follow dark-store/DC dispatch SLA; generate carrier label, manifest, hand-off to carrier
System captures tracking events (carrier API — links to VS-56); push to customer (links to VS-10/VS-13); on delivery, capture POD/e-signature; auto-close order on confirmed delivery
Marketplace Mgr monitor SLA adherence (ship-on-time %, delivery-on-time %, cancellation rate, late-ship rate); under-performers flagged in seller scorecard (W3154) and remediation/penalty path

fields.Participants: Marketplace Mgr, Ecommerce (links to VS-10), CS (links to VS-13), OMS (links to VS-60)

workflows.name: Multi-Seller Basket Split, Consolidation & Customer Experience

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-route of "route via Fulfill-by-BuildRight" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconcile returns/refunds per seller" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-515 (ensure controlled execution — Marketplace Catalog, Order Routing & Seller Fulfillment (PA-95.2).)
- operational: unified tracking, consolidated options, and clear comms
Pain Points / Risks: - **Experience-fragmentation risk**: Multiple deliveries/returns confuse customer; mitigated by unified tracking, consolidated options, and clear comms
System Touchpoints: - Basket/OMS (links to VS-10/VS-60); CS ticketing (links to VS-13); Fulfill-by-BuildRight (links to VS-93)

steps.activity: Ecommerce (links to VS-10) shows customer clear basket view: per-seller grouping, separate shipping thresholds/fees, estimated delivery windows, consolidated vs. split-shipment options where possible

OMS (links to VS-60) orchestrates split: per-seller sub-orders with their respective fulfillment paths; where consolidation beneficial, route via Fulfill-by-BuildRight (links to VS-93) consolidation point
CS (links to VS-13) manage multi-seller order inquiries with unified order view; communicate any per-seller delivery variance; reconcile returns/refunds per seller (W3151)

fields.Participants: Marketplace Mgr, IT, Seller, Ecommerce (links to VS-10)
fields.Trigger: Seller inventory change; order reservation; sync failure

workflows.name: Seller Inventory Sync, Reservation & Oversell Prevention

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-sync of "syncs to listing availability" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-monitor of "monitor sync health" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-515 (ensure controlled execution — Marketplace Catalog, Order Routing & Seller Fulfillment (PA-95.2).)
- operational: real-time sync, atomic reservation, and stale-feed delisting
Pain Points / Risks: - **Oversell risk**: Stale inventory causes cancellation and customer dissatisfaction; mitigated by real-time sync, atomic reservation, and stale-feed delisting
System Touchpoints: - Seller inventory API; reservation engine; ecommerce availability (links to VS-10); refunds (links to VS-80)

steps.activity: Seller maintains inventory via API (real-time), bulk upload, or portal; system syncs to listing availability; quality rules for stale feeds (auto-delist if feed > 24 hr stale)

On order placement: system atomically reserves seller inventory; on oversell (concurrent orders exceed available): cancel, offer back-order, or substitute per seller policy; refund customer if cancelled (links to VS-80)
IT monitor sync health: API uptime, feed freshness, reservation accuracy; alert on anomalies; reconcile against seller reported inventory weekly

fields.Participants: Marketplace Mgr, Seller, CS (links to VS-13), Quality, AP (links to VS-15)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "log return request with reason" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-inspect of "inspects, files dispute if item not as returned" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track return rate per seller to scorecard" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-515 (ensure controlled execution — Marketplace Catalog, Order Routing & Seller Fulfillment (PA-95.2).)
- operational: inspection, evidence capture, and serial tracking (links to VS-23)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Return-abuse risk**: Fake returns, item-swap; mitigated by inspection, evidence capture, and serial tracking (links to VS-23)
System Touchpoints: - Returns workflow (links to VS-32); refund (links to VS-80); settlement debit (links to W3153/VS-15)

steps.activity: CS (links to VS-13) log return request with reason; route to seller; per marketplace policy decide approval (auto-approve for low-value, seller-review for high-value); communicate decision to customer
Customer ships item back (to seller or BuildRight consolidation per policy); on receipt, seller inspects, files dispute if item not as returned; CS mediates disputes

On approval: refund customer (links to VS-80) and debit seller settlement (W3153); item disposition (restock by seller, refurbish — links to VS-09, dispose per VS-73); track return rate per seller to scorecard (W3154)

fields.Participants: Marketplace Mgr, Marketing (links to VS-14), Retail Media (links to VS-48), Finance, Seller
fields.Trigger: Seller promotion request; marketplace campaign cycle

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "reviews for compliance" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "For co-funded campaigns" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-reconcile of "Finance execute seller fee for promotional placement" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-515 (ensure controlled execution — Marketplace Catalog, Order Routing & Seller Fulfillment (PA-95.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Promo-cannibalization risk**: Seller promo undercuts 1P; mitigated by 1P/3P price rules (W3146) and review
System Touchpoints: - Promotion engine (links to VS-14/VS-58); retail-media (links to VS-48); commission (links to W3141)

steps.activity: Seller proposes promotion (discount %, coupon, bundle, free shipping, flash sale); Marketplace Mgr reviews for compliance (MAP/price-floor — links to VS-01, competition law, anti-dumping) and approve/decline
For co-funded campaigns (BuildRight + seller): Marketing (links to VS-14) structures campaign (featured placement, email, push, retail-media — links to VS-48); agree cost-share, KPIs, and reporting
Finance execute seller fee for promotional placement (commission engine — W3141) and reconcile; report promotional lift per seller and to scorecard (W3154)
